items.quote: 18:7 And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
items.claim: Abraham ran to the herd, took a tender, good calf and gave it to a young man (a servant), who quickly prepared it.
items.action: fetched a calf from the herd and gave it to a young man to prepare
items.mechanism: A household servant ('a young man') slaughtered and prepared the animal quickly ('hasted to dress it'). The document calls this verse 18:7 but gives no wider context. Reading it as hospitality toward guests comes only from model-prior and is not in this text.
